valor: Since 1977, peasant women weavers in the mountains of Cundinamarca have resisted the unregulated exploitation of freshwater springs by the beverage and ultra-processed food industries. As water becomes a business, communities endure drought and the decay of their ecosystems. Now, facing a new concession to bottle water, they organize to defend their territory and demand that water remain a right, not a commodity.
